ground_truth_question: What hardware comes in the standard IT enablement kit for employees in India?
ground_truth_answer: The standard IT enablement kit includes a laptop (Windows or Mac), a compatible laptop charger, a wired headset for secure and high‑quality audio, a privacy screen to protect confidential information in public or shared spaces, a data SIM card when required for mobile access, and a Mi‑Fi dongle for Mac users to ensure consistent connectivity. Mobile phones are not provided to users in India under this policy.
exact_excerpt_from_policy:
As part of the IT enablement kit, the following standard hardware will be provided to all end users to ensure secure and efficient operations:
Laptop (Windows or Mac) – Users may choose based on work requirements.
Laptop Charger – Compatible with the issued laptop.
Wired Headset – For secure and high-quality audio communications.
Privacy Screen – To safeguard confidential information during work in public or shared spaces.
Data SIM Card – For mobile data access when required.
Mi-Fi Dongle (for Mac users) – Provided to ensure consistent connectivity.
*Mobile Phones are not provided to users in India.

ground_truth_question: Can I choose between a Windows and a Mac laptop, and what guides that choice?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. You may choose either a Windows or a Mac laptop, and the selection should be based on your work requirements as recognized by the policy.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Laptop (Windows or Mac) – Users may choose based on work requirements.

ground_truth_question: Is a laptop charger included with my issued laptop?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. A laptop charger that is compatible with the issued laptop is part of the standard kit and is provided to every user.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Laptop Charger – Compatible with the issued laptop.

ground_truth_question: Do we receive a wired headset, and why is it specified as wired?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. The policy provides a wired headset to support secure and high‑quality audio communications, which aligns with BCG’s emphasis on secure collaboration.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Wired Headset – For secure and high-quality audio communications.

ground_truth_question: Is a privacy screen provided and what is it for?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. A privacy screen is included to safeguard confidential information, especially when you are working in public or shared spaces.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Privacy Screen – To safeguard confidential information during work in public or shared spaces.

ground_truth_question: Will I be issued a data SIM card by default?
ground_truth_answer: Not by default. A data SIM card is provided when required to enable mobile data access for your work.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Data SIM Card – For mobile data access when required.

ground_truth_question: As a Mac user, am I eligible for a Mi‑Fi dongle and why?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. Mac users are provided a Mi‑Fi dongle to ensure consistent connectivity as part of the standard enablement kit.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Mi-Fi Dongle (for Mac users) – Provided to ensure consistent connectivity.

ground_truth_question: Are corporate mobile phones issued to users in India as part of this policy?
ground_truth_answer: No. The policy explicitly states that mobile phones are not provided to users in India.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: *Mobile Phones are not provided to users in India.

ground_truth_question: Can case teams request additional hardware for project needs?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. Additional hardware can be provided to case teams on request, provided the need is driven by project requirements.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Additional hardware may be provided to case teams on request, based on project needs:

ground_truth_question: What kinds of audio equipment can a case team request for collaboration?
ground_truth_answer: Case teams may request portable speakers with a microphone to support collaborative discussions and meetings when project needs call for it.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Portable Speakers with Microphone – For collaborative discussions and meetings.

ground_truth_question: Are monitors available for extended displays, and why might they be approved?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. Monitors may be provided on request to support extended display needs and improve productivity for case work.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Monitors – To support extended display needs and productivity.

ground_truth_question: Can we request a printer for a project that requires physical documentation?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. Printers may be provided for case‑specific requirements where physical documentation is essential.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Printers – For case-specific requirements where physical documentation is essential.

ground_truth_question: How should a case team submit a hardware request, and is approval required?
ground_truth_answer: Requests must be submitted through Local IT, and they are subject to approval under this policy.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Requests must be made through Local IT and are subject to approval.

ground_truth_question: Who manages procurement and distribution of IT hardware to end users?
ground_truth_answer: The IT team is responsible for procuring and distributing IT hardware to end users, ensuring alignment with organizational standards.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: The IT team is responsible for procuring and distributing IT hardware to end users in line with organizational standards.

ground_truth_question: If I need hardware not included in the kit for legitimate reasons, how is it funded?
ground_truth_answer: If a specific item outside the standard kit is necessary and you have a valid business justification, it can be procured on a case code.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: If a specific hardware item not included in the IT enablement kit is required and has a valid business justification, it can be procured on a case code.

ground_truth_question: What approvals do I need for an exception to procure non‑standard hardware?
ground_truth_answer: Such procurement requires exception approval from both Local IT and the Finance Team before it can proceed.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Such procurement requires exception approval from both Local IT and the Finance Team.

ground_truth_question: How often am I eligible for a laptop refresh?
ground_truth_answer: You are eligible for a laptop refresh every 2.75 years under this policy.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Users are eligible for a laptop refresh every 2.75 years.

ground_truth_question: Do I need to initiate the laptop refresh process, or will someone contact me?
ground_truth_answer: You do not need to initiate it. The Local IT team will proactively reach out to eligible users when they are due for a refresh.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: The Local IT team will proactively reach out to eligible users when they are due for a refresh.

ground_truth_question: Can I choose my replacement laptop model during a refresh?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. At the time of replacement, you may choose from the available models provided by Local IT.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: At the time of replacement, users may choose from the available models provided by Local IT.

ground_truth_question: What is expected of me regarding IT assets when I exit the firm?
ground_truth_answer: You must return all IT assets that have been assigned to you at the time of exit. This includes every item issued under the policy.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Users are required to return all IT assets assigned to them at the time of exit.

ground_truth_question: What happens if I fail to return an IT asset when I leave?
ground_truth_answer: If you do not return an assigned asset, the depreciated cost of the item plus applicable taxes will be recovered from your full and final settlement.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: In the event of non-return, the depreciated cost of the asset plus applicable taxes will be recovered from the user’s full and final settlement.

ground_truth_question: I lost my laptop—what immediate steps must I take?
ground_truth_answer: You must report the loss to the service center immediately so the device can be disabled, and you must file a First Information Report (FIR) and submit a copy to Local IT.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Laptop Loss: Must be reported to the service center immediately so the device can be disabled. Users must file an FIR and submit a copy to Local IT.

ground_truth_question: If an accessory or other non‑laptop IT asset is lost, will I be charged?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. For other assets and accessories, you will be charged the depreciated cost of the asset plus applicable taxes.
exact_excerpt_from_policy: Other Assets/Accessories: Users will be charged the depreciated cost of the asset plus applicable taxes.

ground_truth_question: Who should I contact for hardware support, and who approves any exceptions to the process?
ground_truth_answer: For any hardware‑related queries, you should contact your Local IT team. Any exceptions to the process require approval from Local IT and the Finance Team.
exact_excerpt_from_policy:
For all hardware-related queries, users should contact their respective Local IT teams.
Any exceptions to this process require approval from Local IT and Finance Team.
